description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a Settings tab in an expense tracker app. It manages user interface elements for user information, theme settings (Dark Mode, System Default), logout functionality, and displays app version information.

classes.name: SettingsTab
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget representing the settings tab of the app.

classes.name: _SettingsTabState
classes.description: State class for SettingsTab managing user data, theme preferences, and logout functionality.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state, fetching current user info asynchronously.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the Settings tab UI, including user info display, theme toggles, logout button, and app version info.
